candidate.title: Embed/topic retrieval synchronously runs full feed poll (Jobs::PollFeed) on cache miss, coupling embeds to feed health and enabling resource exhaustion
reports: performretrieve calls jobs::pollfeed.new.execute({}) inline, running a full feed fetch, parse, and import synchronously on every cache-miss embed request with no timeout (lib/topicretriever.rb:44-46)

jobs::pollfeed.new.execute({}) in lib/topicretriever.rb:47 runs a full synchronous feed fetch and import inline on every cache-miss embed request, letting unauthenticated visitors force repeated whole-feed polls

topicretrieverperformretrieve synchronously runs jobs::pollfeed.new.execute({}), re-downloading the entire feed on every embed cache miss; the per-embedurl throttle allows unlimited full-feed fetches (amplification vector)

every retrieval synchronously re-polls the entire feed — jobs::pollfeed.new.execute({}) runs the full feed fetch and import inline inside the retrievetopic job, so any exception while polling propagates and skips fetchhttp, meaning one broken feed item breaks on-demand embedding for every url site-wide and is re-attempted on each job retry
